objective: Validate Full, Fixed Sector, and Adaptive over seven fixed maps with a 0.5 s compute budget only for rest-to-rest planning while preserving the original moving-replan look-ahead deadlines.

stages.stage1: repetitions 1-5; all 35 triplets must pass infrastructure/source gates before stage2

mode_order: Deterministic rotating order within every triplet.
blocking_gate: Stop on any infrastructure/source error, or any Full/Adaptive non-completion, contact, speed violation, or strict recovery-audit failure. Retain Sector safety/non-completion as an outcome if the run is otherwise valid.
required_adaptive_contract: Every completed Full-recovery cycle has exactly one fresh source frame, one committed acknowledgement, one newer certified path and one Sector return; escape-prefix paths retain Full until an ordinary current certificate permits release.
predeclared_metrics: Adaptive Full-open transitions and refresh acknowledgements

prior_evidence.c34_stage1_stop: G3 repeat 1 Full timed out at waypoint 0 after a stopped recovery loop; contact remained zero while Adaptive and Sector completed.
prior_evidence.c34_regression_root_cause: The 0.5 s rest-planning budget had also replaced the moving ReplanOnce deadlines tied to the 0.1 s trajectory look-ahead, permitting stale moving splice attempts that c33 rejected.
prior_evidence.c35_g3_full_gate: Independent run87112 completed 5/5 in 61.79 s with contact 0 and body clearance 0.250 m.
prior_evidence.c35_forest_full_gate: Independent run87100 completed 5/5 in 61.31 s with contact 0 and body clearance 0.232 m, preserving the original c34 Forest recovery.

claim_limit: Finite simulation evidence on the declared maps; not a population-level or real-world guarantee.
